compress.title: Reduce your PDF file size without ever compromising on quality or safety
compress.subtitle: Say "hi" to effortless PDF compression... and "bye" to bloated files, long waiting times and online tools that might leak your data without your knowledge.
compress.subtitle2: With our unique SaferPDF Compressor tool, your files never leave your device. The power of the latest web technologies will help you compress all the PDFs you need in your day-to-day.
compress.tagline: It's safe, it's fast & most importantly, it's private.
compress.dropzone: Drop your files here, or click to select files

merge.title: Merge multiple PDFs into one securely in your browser
merge.subtitle: Combine your PDF files in any order you want. Drag and drop to reorder, then merge with optional compression.
merge.subtitle2: Your files never leave your device - everything happens locally using WebAssembly technology.
merge.dropzone: Drop your PDF files here to merge them, or click to select
merge.dragHint: Drag files to reorder. Files will be merged in this order:
merge.atLeast2: Add at least 2 files to merge
